title: Tried my hand at making a Sudoku game
author: GuideAffectionate901
selftext:
Started off wanting to make a Sudoku game that my wife and I could play together and ended up developing a whole series of puzzle games using this one as a template basically lmao.

It's called [GridMates: Sudoku](https://sir-spudacus.itch.io/gridmates-sudoku). It's got solo, co-op, versus, daily puzzles, 85 collectibles, 47 achievements and quite a bit more than I originally planned.

I've been using AI for a lot of the programming, artwork and whatnot. A few things that have really helped me along the way:

**Keeping GitHub and documentation updated so I can easily pick back up when chats get full.**

**Having AI periodically audit the project instead of just constantly adding features.**

**Actually testing builds. Passing automated tests doesn't necessarily mean something looks or feels good.**

**Creating reusable assets and shared design standards across projects.**

Still got plenty planned for it, including music, expanded collections, improving the Sudoku Coach and maybe eventually getting it onto Google Play.

Nothing crazy, just enjoying a hobby.

It's free on Android if anyone wants to mess around with it. Feedback is always appreciated!

[https://sir-spudacus.itch.io/gridmates-sudoku](https://sir-spudacus.itch.io/gridmates-sudoku)
